description: Returns one deck: its summary, company facts and every listed slide in order with its section. Use it when you need a whole deck; for a single slide call get_slide, and for decks you have no id for call list_decks first. Each slide has n (1-based), section, section_name, label, appendix, image_url, and any verdict, review_point and review_note. Slides belong to the companies that made them; cite the deck source_url when you use one.

id.description: A deck id from list_decks or search_slides, such as "airbnb".

name: get_deck
title: Get a deck
